data.text: Search-quality discovery 2026-09-29 (scratch copy of search.ts, 25 golden + 75 blind): the right record is among lexical candidates for 99/100 questions once the coverage gate is off and plurals/-ed/-ing are folded - the gate (0.35) and the ranking lose it, not the matcher. Question + 3 agent-written phrasings fused by reciprocal rank, light stemming, gate 0.1, 'why' favouring decisions: golden@3 0.92, top-1 59, top-3 82, top-5 87 (today 0.72 / 37 / 52 / 56). Coverage as a score multiplier made everything worse. A glossary written from the golden misses lifted golden by 0.12 and nothing else - fitting. Two benchmark faults: 'how does compaction work' has no record to find, and DEC-28 plus the search notes quote the golden questions verbatim and now outrank the answers - the live-journal benchmark measures what we write about search. Plan: tasks/plan-search-quality.md on the owner's disk.
